test_title: PYST 33: SSC MTS 2022 - Reasoning (Held On: 17 May, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: P, Q, R, S and T are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. R is sitting to the immediate left of T. Q is sitting to the immediate left of S and to the immediate right of T. Who is sitting to the immediate right of S?
solution:
**P, Q, R, S and T** are sitting around a circular table facing the centre.

1. R is sitting to the immediate left of T.

2. Q is sitting to the immediate left of S and to the immediate right of T.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/62b2262aa1138cb0461ec4420ebffe0646eb2d2a108bd6f8452b34933aca7977.png] 

P, the only person left will occupy the vacant position.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b28c8a1ca2419dc313e274f890d6c30014cdbf5ba29f5f3517a7c3d559b731e6.png] 

Clearly, P is sitting to the immediate right of S.

Hence, '**P**' is the correct answer.
